preservation_check.statement: All18 original fenced display-math blocks are retained verbatim, with the explicitly recorded domain qualifications added to the surrounding theorem statements. Section/table/figure references, notation and scope explanations are integrated; no proof source is modified.

review_clarifications.reason: The state modulus divides by |S| and the simple-eigenvalue/equality characterization is not valid for the zero matrix on an empty support.

review_clarifications.change: Require nonzero Pauli expectations on the tested context.
review_clarifications.reason: The sign assignment and the iff metric distinction otherwise fail at zero expectations.

review_clarifications.change: Exclude the identity label from the outside sum.
review_clarifications.reason: b_w is defined only for nonzero outside points.

review_clarifications.change: N>=2 for the quaternionic formula and full-space ratios/noise; fractional table entries require L>0. Pair values need not be distinct.
review_clarifications.reason: Avoid denominators equal to zero and make pair multiplicities explicit. The general Lean count bound remains valid for N>=1 and arbitrary supports.

review_clarifications.change: Replace inherited under5GB resource claim with a pointer to measured CI evidence.
review_clarifications.reason: Verified saturation CI used more than5GiB; performance depends on the execution environment.

review_clarifications.change: Add verified CI run links and bounded audit counts.
review_clarifications.reason: Run records at87f08a0 verify existing proof sources; combining documents creates no new theorem.

review_clarifications.change: Restrict to distinct commuting labels and require their sum in S; Pauli products are considered up to sign.
review_clarifications.reason: A repeated label multiplies to the excluded identity, and context products may carry a minus sign.

review_clarifications.change: Specify Lean proves exact-degree mask/count statements, while state identifications are separately checked.
review_clarifications.reason: A blanket statement that table rows are proved would overstate formal coverage of state, modulus and geometry columns.

review_clarifications.change: Use complementary underlying Pauli label spaces, not signed stabilizer-group intersection.
review_clarifications.reason: Signed stabilizer groups of orthogonal states can intersect only at the identity, so the original wording did not imply mutual unbiasedness.

review_clarifications.change: Nonprincipal character eigenvalues lie among the two candidates; absent classes omitted.
review_clarifications.reason: The complete graph case does not have every candidate eigenvalue.

review_clarifications.change: Keep nonzero-form restriction and distinguish uniqueness of an equivalence class from literal uniqueness.
review_clarifications.reason: The zero form gives flat stabilizer states in every dimension, and the seven-qubit evidence is restricted.

review_clarifications.change: 130816 points and modulus1/16 describe the rank8 candidate family.
review_clarifications.reason: The cited rank formula alone does not force rank8 for every flat phase state on nine qubits.

review_clarifications.change: The two-qubit0.800ceiling uses exactdegree3, not spectralfloor2.
review_clarifications.reason: Distinguishes the stronger independently known bound from the generic floor; numeric table remains unchanged.

review_clarifications.change: Name the odd-qubit constant-rank(N-1) family and the three still-external classical exact values explicitly.
review_clarifications.reason: Avoid excluding the known two-qubit/stabilizer examples or falsely labeling the formal four-qubit hyperbolic degree315 as unformalized.
